mapper.sql: id, username, email, password_hash, name, verification_code, status, role, phone_number, is_verified, created_at, verified_at, code_expires_at, updated_at
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET username = #{username}, email = #{email}, password_hash = #{passwordHash}, name = #{name}, verification_code = #{verificationCode}, status = #{status}, role = #{role}, phone_number = #{phoneNumber}, is_verified = #{isVerified}, verified_at = #{verifiedAt}, code_expires_at = #{codeExpiresAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM users ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT FROM users WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT FROM users WHERE role = #{role} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT FROM users WHERE is_verified = 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT FROM users WHERE code_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND code_expires_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND is_verified = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET status = #{status}, verified_at = #{verifiedAt}, is_verified = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'VERIFIED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{userId}

mapper.select: SELECT FROM users WHERE created_at BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY created_at DESC
